title: How to write a CV in New Zealand: a step-by-step guide
desc: How to write a New Zealand CV: what to include, the right length, referees, and tips that help you get interviews.
blocks: New Zealand employers want a clear CV that shows what you can do and how it fits the job. Here is how to write one.
Your name, mobile number, email address and town or city. You do not need a photo, your date of birth or your full address.
A few lines about who you are, your strengths and what you are looking for. Keep it specific to the role.
Key skills that match the job ad, including licences and tickets (for example a forklift licence or first aid certificate).
Most recent first: job title, employer, location, dates and bullet points with duties and achievements, starting with action verbs.
Qualifications with the institution and year, such as NCEA level, NZ certificates, diplomas or degrees.
Employers in New Zealand usually check references. List two referees with their permission, or say they are available on request.
Two to three pages is normal. Save your CV as a PDF and give it a clear file name.
